content.title: As it happened: Speed record broken as fan favourite puts on a masterclass at Paris-Roubaix 2026
content.text: Refresh The media has, understandably, been focused on defending three time champion, Mathieu van der Poel (Alpecin-Premier Tech) and world champion, Tadej Pogačar (UAE Team Emirates-XRG) before the start of this race. April 12, 2026 at 6:38 AMBonjour, and welcome to Cyclingnews' live report of the 123rd running of the men's Paris-Roubaix. Otherwise known as the 'Hell of the North'. April 12, 2026 at 8:31 AMSign on is well underway for the riders after the team presentation last night. There is just over half an hour until the riders get racing. (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 8:36 AMPogačar believes that he may not need to get away solo to take the Hell of the North...>>> ‘I can pull off some kind of good sprint’ – Does Tadej Pogačar even need to arrive alone to win Paris-Roubaix? (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 8:51 AMJust under 15 minutes to the official start. The riders have just started the neutral zone in Compiègne, (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 8:55 AMJust over 5km to the official start. April 12, 2026 at 9:03 AMAs we wait for the start, why not have a go at our little quiz we put together! Can you name every podium from the last decade? I'll give you a clue, Van der Poel is in a few of them! (Image credit: Luc Claessen/Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 9:03 AMJust 1km to the official start. April 12, 2026 at 9:06 AMThere will be a delayed start as there are some mechanicals. April 12, 2026 at 9:07 AMFabian Lienhard (Tudor) makes it back into the peloton. April 12, 2026 at 9:08 AM 258.3km to go! April 12, 2026 at 9:09 AMNickolas Zukowsky (Pinarello-Q36.5) is one of the first riders to attack. April 12, 2026 at 9:10 AMVan der Poel and three of his teammates are right at the back of the peloton. April 12, 2026 at 9:13 AMSilvan Dillier (Alpecin-Premier Tech) and a few other big names just slipping into the early move. That sees it dragged back, though. The former Swiss champion was second in this race behind the great Peter Sagan. April 12, 2026 at 9:14 AMThree riders get away from Unibet Rose Rockets, Bahrain Victorious and NSN. They have a pretty decent gap on the chasing group and then the peloton. April 12, 2026 at 9:17 AM10km of racing done and the average speed is a staggering 57kph! April 12, 2026 at 9:17 AMThe leading trio have 15" on the peloton. April 12, 2026 at 9:19 AMRear puncture for Nils Politt (UAE Team Emirates-XRG). April 12, 2026 at 9:21 AMThe break is Matevž Govekar (Bahrain Victorious), Riley Sheehan (NSN) and Martijn Rasenberg (Unibet Rose Rockets). They still have 15" gap. Several riders in the gap. April 12, 2026 at 9:25 AMThe leaders have been joined by a rider from Decathlon-CMA CGM. But the gap has dropped to just 5". April 12, 2026 at 9:26 AMNew attacks leaving the front of the peloton. April 12, 2026 at 9:26 AMCees Bol (Decathlon-CMA CGM) is the man who joins the leaders. April 12, 2026 at 9:31 AMBreakaway caught! April 12, 2026 at 9:31 AMNew attacks go straight away, though. Led by Bahrain Victorious and Decathlon-CMA CGM. Yves Lampaert (Soudal-Quickstep) trying to be stealthy and get into the break. April 12, 2026 at 9:33 AMThe two clear are Alessandro Borgo (Bahrain Victorious) and the very talented Stan Dewulf (Decathlon-CMA CGM). (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 9:35 AMModern Adventure leading a new move but too many follow and that gets nowhere. April 12, 2026 at 9:36 AMFlanders-Baloise and XDS-Astana try to get involved, but they are quickly brought back. April 12, 2026 at 9:36 AMIt is just wave after wave of attacks in the peloton. Dewulf and Borgo are still clear by about 5", though. April 12, 2026 at 9:38 AMSlovakian champion, Lukáš Kubiš (Unibet Rose Rockets) and Matthew Brennan (Visma-Lease a Bike) are two standout names right at the very back of the peloton. Brennan finished 44th on debut last year after showing very good legs in support of Van Aert. April 12, 2026 at 9:38 AMModern Adventure get a rider across to Dewulf and Borgo. April 12, 2026 at 9:39 AMA huge attack comes from the peloton and that spells an end to the breakaway yet again. April 12, 2026 at 9:41 AMNSN lead a new move and is caught by a few others including Asian and Kazakhstani champion, Yevgeniy Fedorov (XDS-Astana). But, again, nothing doing. April 12, 2026 at 9:43 AMTomáš Kopecký and Matyáš Kopecký both riding for Unibet Rose Rockets. The two brothers also have their sister, Julia Kopecký racing for SD Worx-Protime. An amazing day for the Kopecký family. April 12, 2026 at 9:46 AMVan Aert, Laporte and Ganna, among others, coming back into the peloton after several riders stop for a nature break. April 12, 2026 at 9:52 AMEmīls Liepiņš (Pinarello-Q36.5) is one of the riders who launches a new move but, again, nothing doing. April 12, 2026 at 9:53 AMFlanders-Baloise launches a new move with Zukowsky and a Tudor rider following but some of the big teams are now getting involved with UAE Team Emirates-XRG starting to control things. April 12, 2026 at 9:56 AMA large group have a decent gap including Kamil Małecki and Zukowsky from Pinarello-Q36.5. April 12, 2026 at 9:56 AMVisma-Lease a Bike try to get a man in the break and this may spell the end for this latest move. April 12, 2026 at 9:59 AMA new move goes and Tadej Pogačar himself is right in the mix for the breakaway with 50km to the first cobbled sector. April 12, 2026 at 10:00 AMPogačar sits up and more moves go yet again. April 12, 2026 at 10:04 AM25 years since Servais Knaven won this race. Today, his daughter, Mirre of EF Education-Oatly, races the same cobbles...>>> A mud-bath, an over-inflated spare tyre, and a domestique holding the cobblestone trophy – Servais Knaven relives his iconic Paris-Roubaix victory 25 years on (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 10:05 AMSo many attacks but nothing is getting away. With this strong tailwind, there is a very big chance that there will be no breakaway at all today. April 12, 2026 at 10:07 AMGroupama-FDJ United now getting involved in the latest moves. Bahrain Victorious and several Modern Adventure riders also at the front. No gap formed yet, though. April 12, 2026 at 10:12 AM 200km to go April 12, 2026 at 10:14 AMLotto-Intermarche get a solo rider clear but he has a long long line leading the peloton. 54kph average speed so far after just over an hour. April 12, 2026 at 10:16 AMThe moves are just utterly ridiculous. So many moves as Visma-Lease a Bike, Ineos Grenadiers and UAE Team Emirates-XRG are trying to get into the break for the first time. (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 10:17 AMFedorov tries to go, yet again. Flying at about 70kph! April 12, 2026 at 10:24 AMThe peloton is stretched right out in a massive line and some splits re starting to appear. Van der Poel and Pogačar not in it but lots of UAE riders as well as Oliver Naesen (Decathlon-CMA CGM) and Mads Pedersen (Lidl-Trek). Previous winner, John Degenkolb (Picnic-PostNL) and former podium sitter Yves Lampaert (Soudal-QuickStep) also in this huge group. April 12, 2026 at 10:25 AMThere's a lot of panic in the peloton with Visma-Lease a Bike frantically riding on the front. More riders trying to bridge the gap between the peloton and the break. Another Visma rider now kick clear and it is down to Alpecin-Premier Tech and Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe leading the chase. April 12, 2026 at 10:26 AMPogačar coming back to the peloton after a nature break with Mick van Dijke (Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe). He has a lot of teammates in the front group. Very interesting situation. April 12, 2026 at 10:26 AMDillier closes things down with Van der Poel in his wheel and the peloton is back together again. April 12, 2026 at 10:29 AMA brief hiatus in attacks comes and goes as another move starts, led by Groupama-FDJ United. April 12, 2026 at 10:30 AMPogačar and Ganna still out the back with the world champion now in the wind. A small moment where the cars weren't with them. But now they get back in. April 12, 2026 at 10:31 AMCofidis tried a new move and, for a moment, it looked like he'd be allowed to go. A few more saw this as a chance and the fight gets going all over again. April 12, 2026 at 10:33 AM20km to go until the first cobbled sector, the Troisvilles à Inchy. April 12, 2026 at 10:35 AM 180km to go April 12, 2026 at 10:42 AMA few riders having to unclip right at the back of the peloton. But no-one goes down. April 12, 2026 at 10:43 AMThe pace rockets in the peloton with just over 10km to the first sector of the day. Sector 30, Troisvilles à Inchy. April 12, 2026 at 10:45 AMEnjoying our live race coverage? Subscribe to Cyclingnews for an all-access pass to our unrivalled reporting of WorldTour racing, bike tech and exclusive in-depth features. Plus, access to the Cyclingnews app to follow the action on-the-go! Find out more. April 12, 2026 at 10:47 AM 170km to go April 12, 2026 at 10:50 AMIneos Grenadiers now appears on the front of the peloton for Ganna. April 12, 2026 at 10:51 AMSo, no breakaway today. The peloton will hit the cobbles all together. April 12, 2026 at 10:52 AMVisma-Lease a Bike, Uno-X Mobility, Decathlon-CMA CGM, Ineos Grenadiers, Alpecin-Premier Tech and UAE Team Emirates-XRG all on the front of the peloton with 165km to go. April 12, 2026 at 10:52 AMBike change for Niklas Märkl (Pinic-PostNL). A nightmare time to get a mechanical with about 3km to the cobbles. April 12, 2026 at 10:54 AM Sector 30, first cobbles Onto the sector 30, Troisvilles à Inchy. The pace is extremely high and, leading onto it, is Edoardo Affini (Visma-Lease a Bike) and Josh tarling (Ineos Grenadiers). (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 10:55 AM Crash! April 12, 2026 at 10:55 AMTarling flicking his elbow, he doesn't want to lead for too long. April 12, 2026 at 10:57 AMConnor Swift (Ineos Grenadiers) and Matthias Vacek (Lidl-Trek) moving to the front too on the early cobbles. April 12, 2026 at 10:57 AMSeveral punctures on this first sector of cobbles with Lorenzo Milesi (Movistar) being one of them. April 12, 2026 at 10:58 AMStafan Bissegger (Decathlon-CMA CGM) rolled off the front but, as they leave the cobbles, he sits up with an XDS-Astana rider going over the top. April 12, 2026 at 10:58 AMMore mechanicals and punctures very early on. April 12, 2026 at 10:59 AMMike Teunissen (XDS-Astana) is the rider who is solo out front. April 12, 2026 at 11:00 AMSo many mechanicals and punctures with various teams involved. April 12, 2026 at 11:01 AMJonas Abrahamsen (Uno-X Mobility) was one of the riders caught out. April 12, 2026 at 11:02 AMPuncture for Mads Pedersen (Lidl-Trek) and he stops for a bike change. Lidl-Trek said that their new special double inner tube/tubeless tyres were puncture proof. The first cobbled sector proves otherwise. April 12, 2026 at 11:03 AM Sector 29, Viesly à Quiévy Teunissen leads onto the Viesly à Quiévy sector with about 10" on the peloton. Pedersen 38" out the back. April 12, 2026 at 11:04 AMPedersen trying to quickly make his way through the cars but is being kicked about all over the pave. April 12, 2026 at 11:04 AMSo much wasted energy for the former world champion. April 12, 2026 at 11:04 AMUAE Team Emirates-XRG leading the peloton with Pogačar in fourth wheel. April 12, 2026 at 11:05 AMMolano leading the peloton and Teunissen is caught. (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 11:06 AMThey leave sector 29. Pedersen had to negotiate a few stopped cars who were servicing riders. He joins William Blume Levy (Uno-X Mobility) at the back of the peloton. So many riders stopping with issues. Including Toon Aerts (Lotto-Intermarche). April 12, 2026 at 11:07 AM Sector 28, Quiévy à Fontaine April 12, 2026 at 11:08 AMPedersen is back in the peloton. A teammate will now come back for him to try and move him up but he needs to try and stay calm. Something I would definitely be struggling with in his situation. Fortunately, I only have to do it on Pro Cycling Manager! April 12, 2026 at 11:08 AMThe riders are surrounded by the yellow flowers of the Oil Seed Rape fields. April 12, 2026 at 11:09 AMFront puncture for former Tour of Flanders winner, Kasper Asgreen (EF Education-EasyPost). April 12, 2026 at 11:11 AMMechanical for Titouan Fontaine (Groupama-FDJ United). (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 11:12 AMUAE Team Emirates-XRG, Alpecin-Premier Tech and Soudal-Quickstep leading the peloton as they finish sector 28. April 12, 2026 at 11:15 AMMechanical for Wout Van Aert! He has Owain Doull coming back for him. Bike change for Abrahamsen as well. A UAE Team Emirates-XRG rider with an issue too. April 12, 2026 at 11:16 AM Sector 27, Viesly à Briastre April 12, 2026 at 11:17 AMAntonio Morgado (UAE Team Emirates-XRG) leads the peloton now. Pogačar is right up at the front with Florian Vermeersch. April 12, 2026 at 11:17 AMArnaud De Lie (Lotto-Intermarche) out of the back. April 12, 2026 at 11:19 AMSector 27 done and very dusted. The dust cloud is huge. April 12, 2026 at 11:21 AM Sector 26, Briastre April 12, 2026 at 11:21 AMIssues for Lampaert now as well. He's out the back on the Briaste sector as the head of the bunch leaves that sector. April 12, 2026 at 11:24 AMGroups all over the road with Kubis being one of the riders caught out. April 12, 2026 at 11:24 AMHuge gap between the front group and the second. Mikkel Bjerg leading the way for UAE, now. April 12, 2026 at 11:25 AMPuncture for Lukáš Kubiš. April 12, 2026 at 11:26 AMBjerg is going flat out on the front of the peloton. The team of the world champion are destroying the peloton. April 12, 2026 at 11:28 AMLots of Visma and Ineos riders in the second group that are over 30" down. Molano and Oliveira in that group as well after doing their job for UAE. April 12, 2026 at 11:28 AMThe pace eases a bit and more teams come to the front of what is left of the peloton. April 12, 2026 at 11:30 AM Sector 25, Solesmes à Haussy April 12, 2026 at 11:31 AMThere's a bit of crosswind on this sector. Pogačar in second wheel. Van der Poel in about seventh wheel. Van Aert, Pedersen and Ganna all poorly placed with the latter right at the back of the peloton. April 12, 2026 at 11:36 AMPuncture for Per Strand Hagenes (Visma-Lease a Bike). He drops out of the front peloton. April 12, 2026 at 11:36 AM Sector 24, Saulzoir à Verchain-Maugré April 12, 2026 at 11:38 AMGanna still at the back with Tibor Del Grosso (Alpecin-Premier Tech) and Marco Haller (Tudor) as Morgado is dropped. April 12, 2026 at 11:39 AMJonathan Milan (Lidl-Trek), Biniam Girmay (NSN) and Jasper Philipsen (Alpecin-Premier Tech) all looking good early doors. April 12, 2026 at 11:41 AMRasmus Tiller (Uno-X Mobility) leads his team's train as Abrahamsen is in the second group. April 12, 2026 at 11:42 AMBjerg back on the front of the peloton. April 12, 2026 at 11:43 AM Sector 23, Verchain-Maugré à Quérénaing April 12, 2026 at 11:44 AM Crash! April 12, 2026 at 11:45 AMTarling coming down after a frustrating season so far...>>> ‘I feel dead fit but just slow’ – Josh Tarling lacking top-end power for Paris-Roubaix (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 11:47 AM Sector 22, Quérénaing à Maing April 12, 2026 at 11:48 AMTurner just about to get back on as they start this three start sector. April 12, 2026 at 11:49 AM Puncture for Pogačar (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 11:50 AMPogačar looks very uncomfortable on the Shimano neutral bike. Alpecin-Premier Tech and Visma-Lease a Bike lead the front peloton. April 12, 2026 at 11:51 AMPuncture for former winner, Dylan van Baarle (Soudal-Quickstep). April 12, 2026 at 11:52 AM Sector 21, Maing à Monchaux-sur-Écaillon Pogačar getting very frustrated with no team car near him yet. All his riders drop back apart from Vermeersch. April 12, 2026 at 11:53 AMPuncture for Dillier. April 12, 2026 at 11:54 AMPogačar is about 45" down on the now Visma led peloton. Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe also leading the bunch with Alpecin-Premier Tech. April 12, 2026 at 11:54 AMPogačar finally has a car who has come to the middle of the group. They're very panicked. April 12, 2026 at 11:55 AMBike change for Pogačar. He shouts at the TV moto to get out of the way. He seems very rattled. April 12, 2026 at 11:57 AMMorgado is now with Pogačar and now Politt is dropping back, too. He is now 45" behind the peloton. April 12, 2026 at 11:58 AMIt is the longest gap between sectors now, so a good opportunity for UAE to bring things back together again. April 12, 2026 at 11:59 AMBjerg and Politt drop back for Pogačar. They are frantically chasing for the world champion. April 12, 2026 at 12:00 PMThe pace is very high in both groups. Pogačar is now 35" off the back of the peloton that is led by Visma-Lease a Bike and Alpecin-Premier Tech. April 12, 2026 at 12:06 PM Sector 20, Haveluy à Wallers A few years ago, Visma-Lease a Bike detonated the race on this sector. Now, they are working with Alpecin-Premier Tech with a 20" lead over the Pogačar group. Pinarello-Q36.5 doing a lot of work in the bunch as well for Fred Wright. Ineos Grenadiers also well placed. April 12, 2026 at 12:07 PMPogačar down to just Politt in the chase group. If he has an issue on this four star sector, that could be that for the world champion. April 12, 2026 at 12:08 PMPhilipsen leading the peloton ahead of Van der Poel out front as Pogačar is doing it on his own and is now 30" out the back. April 12, 2026 at 12:09 PM Attack! The three time winner goes all in with 103km to go! This is the best way to completely kill off the chances of Pogačar. April 12, 2026 at 12:10 PMVan der Poel is not going full, yet. He has Laurence Pithie (Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe) on his wheel. Philipsen, Pedersen, Van Aert, Hoole, Laporte, Bissegger and a few others. April 12, 2026 at 12:10 PMOff sector 20 and Van der Poel looks around to ask for help. Will anyone give it with 7km to go to the Arenberg? April 12, 2026 at 12:11 PMThe answer is yes. Van Aert comes through with Teunissen and Hoole. Van der Poel looking very twitchy. 18" back to Pogačar. April 12, 2026 at 12:12 PMInto the final 100km and Pogačar has a long line of the domestiques of his main rivals on his wheel. April 12, 2026 at 12:13 PMThe front group has eased dramatically with a lot of looking around. Gianni Vermeersch (Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe) comes back to the front. April 12, 2026 at 12:14 PMPogačar joins the second group on the road and is now about 10" off the back of the front of the race as they head to the Arenberg. April 12, 2026 at 12:16 PMFlorian Vermeersch drops back and drags Tadej Pogačar back into the lead group. Vermeersch straight to the front. April 12, 2026 at 12:17 PM Sector 19, Trouée d'Arenberg April 12, 2026 at 12:18 PMPogačar having to make another effort to move up as Brennan sits up and Van Aert leads onto the cobbles. April 12, 2026 at 12:19 PMHuge crowds on the trench today as the riders battle to try and move up off the main racing line. Van Aert and Van der Poel well placed. (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 12:19 PM Multiple crashes April 12, 2026 at 12:20 PM Bike change for Van der Poel April 12, 2026 at 12:21 PMDel Grosso is taking the wheel off his bike and puts it on his leader's bike. April 12, 2026 at 12:22 PMVan der Poel is now 1'30" behind the lead group of seven that includes Van Aert and Pogačar. April 12, 2026 at 12:23 PM Puncture April 12, 2026 at 12:24 PMVan der Poel finally gets the bike change from his team car and leaves the Arenberg. He actually looks remarkably calm. April 12, 2026 at 12:25 PMLeaders:Tadej Pogačar (UAD)Wout Van Aert (TVL)Chrisophe Laporte (TVL)Mads Pedersen (LTK)Jasper Stuyven (SOQ)Laurence Pithie (RBH)Stefan Bissegger (DCT) (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 12:27 PM Sector 18, Wallers à Hélesmes Van der Poel is now closing a bit. 1'58" down as Pogačar pushes the pace out front. April 12, 2026 at 12:29 PM25" between the lead group and the first chase group that includes Ganna. April 12, 2026 at 12:29 PMPithie bouncing his bike to check if he has a puncture. April 12, 2026 at 12:30 PMGanna only has Jordi Meeus (Red Bull-Bora-Hansgrohe) with him just 19" off the front. April 12, 2026 at 12:31 PMVan der Poel comes to the front of the main chase group and is now over two minutes down. April 12, 2026 at 12:32 PMVan der Poel now has Philipsen to help him with a few other riders working hard for their own chances. April 12, 2026 at 12:32 PMGanna and Meeus are now just 5" off the front group with 85km to go. April 12, 2026 at 12:35 PM Sector 17, Hornaing à Wandignies Pogačar (UAD)Van Aert (TVL)Laporte (TVL)Pedersen (LTK)Ganna (IGD)Pithie (RBH)Meeus (RBH)Stuyven (SOQ)Bissegger (DCT) Chase group 1 +41"Van der Poel group +1'39" April 12, 2026 at 12:37 PMAnother puncture for Ganna who has given so much to get back to the front is now out the back again as Pogačar is really pushing on this four star sector. April 12, 2026 at 12:38 PMPhilipsen leads Van der Poel onto sector 17 and the defending champion looks locked in and is very focused. April 12, 2026 at 12:39 PM80km to go as Ganna is now over 40 seconds back. Van der Poel is slowly closing the gap at 1'27" now. April 12, 2026 at 12:39 PMPogačar is giving it a lot of welly on this sector as Meeus is being distanced after all the work he did with Ganna to get back in. April 12, 2026 at 12:40 PMVan der Poel has Politt, Brennan, Turner and a couple of others on his wheel, but he has destroyed that chase group. April 12, 2026 at 12:41 PMVan der Poel drops Brennan and catches Milan, but Pogačar has dragged the gap back to 1'33" as Van Aert comes through at the front. April 12, 2026 at 12:41 PMPithie with a puncture! Meeus stops to give him his wheel. April 12, 2026 at 12:42 PMMeeus and Pithie now both riding with the Belgian sprinter working for his leader who has looked in amazing form. April 12, 2026 at 12:43 PMLeaders have 49" on Pithie and Meeus then 1'06" to the Ineos led Ganna group and then 1'33" to the Van der Poel group. April 12, 2026 at 12:45 PM Sector 16, Warlaing à Brillon April 12, 2026 at 12:45 PMVan der Poel has Politt, Heiduk and Milan on his wheel. Three riders who will absolutely not work with him. April 12, 2026 at 12:46 PMPIthie leads Meeus behind on the Warlaing à Brillon as he tries to get back to the leaders. April 12, 2026 at 12:47 PMVan der Poel is flying, just 1'27" further back than where he wants to be. (Image credit: Getty Images) April 12, 2026 at 12:48 PMMilan punctures out of the Van der Poel group. April 12, 2026 at 12:49 PM Bike change Tadej Pogačar with another bike change! This is bizarre how many issues the big leaders are having. April 12, 2026 at 12:50 PM Sector 15, Tilloy à Sars-et-Rosières Pogačar much calmer this time and is just 10" down. April 12, 2026 at 12:51 PM Bike change! Pogačar has already gone passed the Belgian as Pedersen, who had his issue long before everyone else, is puching the pace with Stuyven. This race is bonkers! April 12, 2026 at 12:52 PMVan Aert looks to be dropping Pithie who has been having to push for a while since his puncture. April 12, 2026 at 12:53 PMVan der Poel starting to distance Politt and Heiduk in his quest to return to the front, but he is still 1'26" back on the leaders. April 12, 2026 at 12:55 PMVan der Poel makes it to the Ganna group at 1'14". April 12, 2026 at 12:56 PMPogačar back with Pedersen, Laporte, Stuyven and Bissegger. April 12, 2026 at 12:56 PMVan Aert with Pithie and Meeus at 25" as Laporte tries to slow things down in the lead group. April 12, 2026 at 12:57 PMVan der Poel and Ganna chatting in their group that are now 1'07" behind the leaders. April 12, 2026 at 12:58 PM Sector 14, Beuvry-la-Forêt à Orchies Pogačar back onto the front with Van Aert, Meeus and Pithie 17" down on the leaders. Just over a minute back to Van der Poel, Ganna and the rest. April 12, 2026 at 1:01 PMPithie is pushing hard and passes Van Aert, dropping Meeus. They're together again now at just 16" back on the leaders. April 12, 2026 at 1:03 PMVan Aert, Pithie and Meeus are so close but so far from the back of the leading group with 60km to go. April 12, 2026 at 1:04 PM1'02" back from the front, Van der Poel and Ganna are working together well. April 12, 2026 at 1:04 PMVan Aert, Pithie and Meeus rejoin the leaders again. April 12, 2026 at 1:05 PM Sector 13, Orchies April 12, 2026 at 1:06 PMMeeus goes to the front of the lead group for Pithie on this Orchies sector. April 12, 2026 at 1:07 PMThe average speed is sat at 50kph in this astonishingly fast race. Van der Poel now just 37" down! April 12, 2026 at 1:08 PMVan der Poel has Gianni Vermeersch, Ganna and Tim van Dijke on his wheel. April 12, 2026 at 1:09 PMThe contrast between Van der Poel and his issues with Pogačar when he had his issues. Van der Poel has been cool, calm and collected. Pogačar has been far happier since getting back into the peloton. April 12, 2026 at 1:09 PMPolitt gets back onto Van der Poel's group again. Pogačar could maybe be getting a teammate back. April 12, 2026 at 1:11 PMThis is very cagey in the front. Van der Poel is now 22" behind them. April 12, 2026 at 1:13 PM Sector 12, Auchy-lez-Orchies à Bersée Wout Van Aert attacks! Pogačar chasing hard and makes it back to him. April 12, 2026 at 1:14 PMVan Aert, Pogačar and Pedersen go clear and drop the rest. 22" back to a violently chasing Van der Poel. April 12, 2026 at 1:15 PM Attack! Tadej Pogačar April 12, 2026 at 1:15 PMGanna dropped by Van der Poel as he is closing the gap rapidly. April 12, 2026 at 1:17 PMVan Aert gaps Pogačar! But the world champion gets back to the Belgian. April 12, 2026 at 1:17 PMVan der Poel had to unclip as a moto was in the way with Tim van Dijke on his wheel at 23" from Pogačar and Van Aert. April 12, 2026 at 1:18 PMvan Dijke now working with Van der Poel as he has Meeus and Pithie ahead of him. April 12, 2026 at 1:19 PMYet another puncture for Ganna. Meeus actually in that group, not the Vand der Poel group. April 12, 2026 at 1:19 PM Crash!
